subtitleTranslations.fil: Yunit 2, Kabanata 6 — Ang Banal na Espiritu

panels.scene: Jacob and Salome sitting beside the spring under the sun, still deep in conversation. The sun blazes overhead. Teaches: καῦμα (heat), ἥλιος (sun), πηγή (spring), λαλέω (to speak).
panels.greekCaption: ἔτι λαλεῖ ὁ Ἰάκωβος τῇ Σαλώμῃ. ὁ ἥλιος λάμπει σφόδρα καὶ καῦμα μέγα ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob is still speaking to Salome. The sun shines greatly and there is great heat.

captionTranslations.es: Jacobo sigue hablando con Salomé. El sol brilla con fuerza y hay un gran calor.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub wciąż rozmawia z Salome. Słońce mocno świeci i panuje wielki upał.
captionTranslations.fil: Nagsasalita pa si Jacob kay Salome. Maliwanag ang araw at matinding init.

panels.scene: A traveller and his donkey walking along a dusty road in the heat, both appearing weary and thirsty. Teaches: ξένος (stranger), ὄνος (donkey), διψάω (to thirst), ἀκολουθέω (to follow).
panels.greekCaption: ξένος τις ἔρχεται πρὸς τὴν πηγήν. ὁ ὄνος αὐτοῦ ἀκολουθεῖ αὐτῷ. ἀμφότεροι διψῶσιν.
panels.englishCaption: A certain stranger comes toward the spring. His donkey follows him. Both thirst.

captionTranslations.es: Cierto forastero se acerca al manantial. Su asno lo sigue. Ambos tienen sed.
captionTranslations.pl: Pewien nieznajomy idzie ku źródłu. Jego osioł go podąża. Obaj pragną.
captionTranslations.fil: May estranherong lumapit sa bukal. Sumusunod sa kanya ang kanyang asno. Pareho silang nauuhaw.

panels.scene: The stranger greeting Jacob and Salome warmly by the spring, hands extended. Teaches: ἀσπάζομαι (to greet), ξένος (stranger/guest).
panels.greekCaption: ἀσπάζεται ὁ ξένος τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὴν Σαλώμην, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀσπάζονται αὐτόν.
panels.englishCaption: The stranger greets Jacob and Salome, and they greet him.

captionTranslations.es: El forastero saluda a Jacobo y a Salomé, y ellos lo saludan.
captionTranslations.pl: Nieznajomy wita Jakuba i Salome, a oni go witają.
captionTranslations.fil: Binabati ng estranghero si Jacob at si Salome, at sila ay bumabati sa kanya.

panels.scene: Salome rising and drawing water from the spring, giving it to the stranger and his donkey. Teaches: ἀνίσταμαι (to rise), ἀντλέω (to draw water), δίδωμι (to give).
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη ἀνίσταται καὶ ἀντλεῖ ὕδωρ. δίδωσιν τῷ ξένῳ καὶ τῷ ὄνῳ αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Salome rises and draws water. She gives it to the stranger and his donkey.

captionTranslations.es: Salomé se levanta y saca agua. La da al forastero y a su asno.
captionTranslations.pl: Salome wstaje i czerpie wodę. Daje ją nieznajomemu i jego osłowi.
captionTranslations.fil: Tumindig si Salome at umigib ng tubig. Ibinibigay niya ito sa estranghero at sa kanyang asno.

panels.scene: The three resting together under a large tree; the stranger asks what they were discussing. Teaches: ἀναπαύομαι (to rest), ἐρωτάω (to ask), συνίημι (to understand).
panels.greekCaption: εἶτα καθίζουσιν ὑπὸ τῷ δένδρῳ. ὁ ξένος ἐρωτᾷ· τί λαλεῖτε, ὦ φίλοι;
panels.englishCaption: Then they sit under the tree. The stranger asks: What are you speaking about, O friends?

captionTranslations.es: Luego se sientan bajo el árbol. El forastero pregunta: ¿De qué habláis, amigos?
captionTranslations.pl: Potem siedzą pod drzewem. Nieznajomy pyta: O czym mówicie, przyjaciele?
captionTranslations.fil: Pagkatapos ay umupo sila sa ilalim ng puno. Tinanong ng estranghero: Ano ang inyong pinag-uusapan, mga kaibigan?

panels.scene: Jacob speaking with hands raised, explaining about the Holy Spirit being given by God. Teaches: πνεῦμα (spirit), πέμπω (to send), δίδοται (is given — passive), μαρτυρέω (to bear witness).
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος λέγει· τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον δίδοται καὶ πέμπεται ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob says: The Holy Spirit is given and sent by God.

captionTranslations.es: Jacobo dice: El Espíritu Santo es dado y enviado por Dios.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub mówi: Duch Święty jest dawany i posyłany przez Boga.
captionTranslations.fil: Sinabi ni Jacob: Ang Banal na Espiritu ay ibinibigay at ipinapadala ng Diyos.

panels.scene: Jacob explaining the role of the Paraclete — a light or dove imagery with figures listening intently. Teaches: παράκλητος (Advocate/Helper), ὁδηγέω (to guide), διδάσκω (to teach), εἰρήνη (peace).
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιόν ἐστιν ὁ παράκλητος. διδάσκει ἡμᾶς καὶ ὁδηγεῖ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ.
panels.englishCaption: The Holy Spirit is the Paraclete. He teaches us and guides us in the truth.

captionTranslations.es: El Espíritu Santo es el Paráclito. Nos enseña y nos guía en la verdad.
captionTranslations.pl: Duch Święty jest Pocieszycielem. Uczy nas i prowadzi w prawdzie.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang Banal na Espiritu ay ang Parakleto. Itinuturo niya sa atin at ginagabayan tayo sa katotohanan.

panels.scene: The stranger and Salome sitting in peaceful silence, words settling into their hearts. Teaches: εἰρήνη (peace), κοινωνία (fellowship), μένω (to remain), καρδία (heart).
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ξένος καὶ ἡ Σαλώμη σιγῶσιν. τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ Ἰακώβου μένει ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν.
panels.englishCaption: The stranger and Salome are silent. The words of Jacob remain in their hearts.

captionTranslations.es: El forastero y Salomé guardan silencio. Las palabras de Jacobo permanecen en sus corazones.
captionTranslations.pl: Nieznajomy i Salome milczą. Słowa Jakuba pozostają w ich sercach.
captionTranslations.fil: Tahimik ang estranghero at si Salome. Ang mga salita ni Jacob ay nananatili sa kanilang mga puso.
